title_zh: GUI-HARVEST：通过证据驱动的执行框架演化实现自我改进的GUI智能体
one_line: Evolves the executable harness around a frozen GUI model from repeated multimodal runs; held-out OSWorld-Verified gains on six backbones and WAA transfer.
one_line_zh: 用重复执行证据演化冻结模型的执行框架代码，OSWorld留出集提升并迁移WAA。

online_eval.quote: Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models

held_out_env.quote: Frozen-harness transfer to WindowsAgentArena (WAA) at 50 steps raises Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and GPT-5 scores by 6.47 and 13.87 points, respectively, without WAA optimization

strong_baselines.quote: Table 2 shows that, from the same initial Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct/Agent S3 harness, GUI-HARVEST gains 10.16 Test points, versus 2.00 for Self-Harness and 4.38 for Meta-Harness

budget_matched.quote: Figure 1 compares the harnesses optimized by GUI-HARVEST against existing widely adopted GUI models and harnesses, with backbones and step budgets matched.

cost_reported.quote: With GPT-5, our 15-step harness nearly matches Agent S3’s accuracy (62.4% versus 62.6%) at approximately 72% lower full-suite API cost ($72 versus $260).

component_ablation.quote: Removing visual evidence produces the largest drop, to 44.54% and 40.69%, highlighting its value for GUI failure diagnosis.

validator_check.quote: For each targeted search task, a separate validator compares the frozen prediction and pre-edit task-local finding with the post-edit K -run trajectories and available screen evidence.

evidence_level.quote: Frozen-harness transfer to WindowsAgentArena (WAA) at 50 steps raises Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and GPT-5 scores by 6.47 and 13.87 points, respectively, without WAA optimization

S1.quote: Only Search trajectories supply optimization evidence; Validation exposes aggregate scores, and Test is used only after harness optimization.

S2.quote: Removing the Cross-task Clusterer yields 45.66% and 42.13%, supporting cross-task aggregation to guide reusable harness changes.

S5.quote: GUI-HARVEST turns repeated multimodal execution evidence into reusable harness changes, validated by task performance and predicted behavior.

F2.quote: These checks establish evidence consistency, while the behavioral interpretation remains the analyst’s assessment.

AP4.quote: For each targeted search task, a separate validator compares the frozen prediction and pre-edit task-local finding with the post-edit K -run trajectories and available screen evidence.

AP5.quote: A fixed, domain-stratified random split assigns 80 tasks to Search, 80 to Validation, and 201 to sealed Test while preserving each domain’s proportion.

title_zh: AutoGUIWorld：以图像生成器作为GUI智能体的视觉世界模型
one_line: Planner plus image-editing generator synthesises desktop trajectories without running apps; SFT lifts OSWorld 33.0->40.8 and ScienceBoard 14.0->32.2, single run, no real anchor.
one_line_zh: 图像生成器作世界模型合成桌面轨迹并SFT，OSWorld提升但单次运行无真实锚定

online_eval.quote: Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%.

held_out_env.quote: For benchmark-derived tasks, AutoGUIWorld maps the benchmark metadata to the seed sampler, for example by pinning the required foreground application and adding related background windows when the task spans multiple applications.

variance.quote: We fine-tune Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these trajectories to obtain AGW-35B and test six checkpoints from one run on five benchmarks.

strong_baselines.quote: AGW-35B at step 469 exceeds the best evaluated AgentNet checkpoint on all four benchmarks, with the largest gap on ScienceBoard (32.2% versus 16.8%).

cost_reported.quote: Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome.

validator_check.quote: Across 42,526 evaluable desktop transitions, our VLM audit flags 1,293 action–image inconsistencies (3.04%).

evidence_level.quote: Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%.

F3.quote: it captures the visible window layout, page content, foreground application, interface controls, visual style, and interaction context at step t , but it is not equivalent to the full underlying system state such as file-system contents, application internals, or browser DOM state.

F4.quote: Image2 can produce a visually plausible next screen that does not faithfully realize the preceding action.

F5.quote: Across 42,526 evaluable desktop transitions, our VLM audit flags 1,293 action–image inconsistencies (3.04%).

F6.quote: Both runs start from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: AGW-35B uses approximately 80k synthetic examples, while the AgentNet run uses 350k examples and continues through step 686.

AP1.quote: Repeating this process converts the planned action sequence into a temporally linked screenshot trajectory.

AP2.quote: We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments.

AP3.quote: Across 42,526 evaluable desktop transitions, our VLM audit flags 1,293 action–image inconsistencies (3.04%).

AP5.quote: For benchmark-derived tasks, AutoGUIWorld maps the benchmark metadata to the seed sampler, for example by pinning the required foreground application and adding related background windows when the task spans multiple applications.

AP8.quote: We fine-tune Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these trajectories to obtain AGW-35B and test six checkpoints from one run on five benchmarks.

AP9.quote: These results show that synthetic GUI data can match or exceed real demonstrations for post-training in this comparison. The runs use different inference settings

title_zh: 并非所有经验都应写入权重：自我改进GUI智能体的组件路由
one_line: Splits an agent's own experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons, routing each to context or weights; checker-scored held-out apps, three backbones and seeds.
one_line_zh: 将自身经验按组件路由到上下文或权重，留出应用、多骨干、三种子验证。

online_eval.quote: Held-out success is decided by each environment’s deterministic checker, with no model judge.

held_out_env.quote: AndroidWorld has 116 tasks on 20 real applications and an accessibility tree; 12 applications provide experience, 8 are held out, and 58 held-out tasks are run with four instances each

variance.quote: Subscripts are the std over three seeds.

strong_baselines.quote: Every backbone also runs without experience and with undivided whole trajectories: success-filtered fine-tuning on entire trajectories, retrieval of one similar trajectory, retrieval of ten step-level records by task similarity, and context-then-distill.

component_ablation.quote: an eightfold training dose moves procedures toward the weights by +3.5 points, and stripping the state condition from state facts costs 3.4.

code.quote: Code and data will be released.

evidence_level.quote: AndroidWorld has 116 tasks on 20 real applications and an accessibility tree; 12 applications provide experience, 8 are held out, and 58 held-out tasks are run with four instances each

S1.quote: A fixed rank rule holds out 5 applications; the remaining training templates form the pool (122 templates), and the test templates form two held-out tiers

S2.quote: routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone.

S5.quote: Against the base agent and pooled over backbones (Figure 4 c), the context gains between +1.8 and +5.2 points and the weights between +0.8 and +6.7

title_zh: 何时编译计算机使用智能体？衡量回本次数并为令牌效率做出编译决策
one_line: Measures cost and payback of compiling repeated GUI procedures into programs and decides online when to compile; simulated streams save 17.3% tokens versus ReAct.
one_line_zh: 测量GUI流程编译为程序的回本次数并在线决定何时编译，模拟中省17.3%令牌。

online_eval.quote: We simulate task execution and compilation using measured cost profiles on synthetic streams and recorded arrival orders.

held_out_env.quote: Thirty fresh deployment tasks provide a separate evaluation, including model-based binding extraction.

variance.quote: On the recorded logs, PACE reduces token costs by 17.34\% relative to ReAct, with a conditional 95\% interval of [14.96,19.61]\% (Table 3 ).

strong_baselines.quote: We compare PACE with ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) and decision-rule adaptations of AutoRPA ( Chen et al., 2026a ) and ToolPro ( Liu et al., 2026 ) under the same compiler and cost model.

budget_matched.quote: All policies pay the same routing, extraction, fallback, and actual compilation charges, so differences in compiler quality do not affect this comparison of decision rules.

cost_reported.quote: Among DeepSeek attempts with complete charge records, failed attempts have median cost 1701 K tokens, compared with 259 K for successful attempts

component_ablation.quote: Removing the savings test raises mean cost on the recorded logs by 52.68\% (conditional 95\% interval [48.25,58.36]\% ).

code.quote: The code and saved records are at https://github.com/myl7/computer-use .

evidence_level.quote: We simulate task execution and compilation using measured cost profiles on synthetic streams and recorded arrival orders.

S1.quote: Following AutoRPA’s translation and construction stages ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , we compile k=3 completed agent traces and permit bounded repair.

S5.quote: In simulations using recorded task arrivals, PACE reduces token costs by 17.3% compared with ReAct

AP8.quote: We used these grids while developing PACE, so the comparisons are not independent confirmation.

title_zh: WebFovea：模型正确但点击错误——面向真实网站视觉网页智能体的可靠往返
one_line: Hardens parsing, execution, feedback and observation in a vision web agent's harness; hidden live-site score 31.0->57.0 with one model, single runs, tiny ablations.
one_line_zh: 加固视觉网页智能体执行框架四环节，同模型隐藏集得分31升至57，单次运行。

online_eval.quote: The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer.

held_out_env.quote: Teams submit code to a private repository, and the organizers run it on 100 hidden tasks in a designated sandbox, as the challenge rules require

variance.quote: Sites change and some were unreachable from our network, so repeated runs of the same version vary, and each official score comes from a single run.

strong_baselines.quote: No same-model baseline on the hidden set. We never submitted the reference implementation itself, so the 31.0 starting point already includes several of our fixes

cost_reported.quote: The average step consumed about 10.6k input and 127 output tokens; input exceeded output 83-fold

component_ablation.quote: On a paired set of 24 dev tasks, success rose from 8/24 to 20/24 with the version containing this fix (12 fixed, 0 broken)

evidence_level.quote: The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer.

S5.quote: When an action lands in a child frame and neither frame changes (as detected by the feedback stage, § 4.4 ), the executor dispatches a complete sequence of DOM mouse events inside that frame

AP8.quote: Component evidence comes from targeted sets of 1–24 tasks and shows direction, not significance.

AP9.quote: No same-model baseline on the hidden set. We never submitted the reference implementation itself, so the 31.0 starting point already includes several of our fixes

AP15.quote: All results use claude-opus-4-6 . The four-stage view is model-agnostic, but we have not shown that each fix transfers

title_zh: CUAWright：面向数字智能体的极简统一接口
one_line: Replaces GUI-native harnesses with bash as sole action plus a file-system tool workspace; gains on OSWorld 2.0, Online-Mind2Web, Odysseys, CAD, frontier models only.
one_line_zh: 以bash为唯一动作接口加文件系统工具，网页、桌面、CAD均提升，仅用前沿模型。

online_eval.quote: On OSWorld 2.0, CUAWright delivers a 33.2% relative improvement in partial reward while reducing estimated cost by 37.5% compared with the published GPT-5.5 baseline.

strong_baselines.quote: Table 3 shows that CUAWright passes 61 of 114 tasks, improving PassRate from 35.1\% to 53.5\% and substantially improves the overall score from 49.9 to 66.4 compared to the Codex harness.

budget_matched.quote: We take the corpus and run settings from the benchmark’s published GPT-5.5 high + Codex CLI configuration: the pinned 114-task dataset, high reasoning effort, and a 200-step limit.

cost_reported.quote: With GPT-5.5 xhigh, CUAWright improves the performance by 15.7 points over the corresponding OpenAI baseline while reducing the cost by $6.0 per task.

component_ablation.quote: restricting the agent from programmatic access to file system leads to a significant decrease in the performance of GPT 5.6 Sol (-12.1 pts).

validator_check.quote: It includes 300 tasks spanning 136 popular websites across diverse domains, with an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator for assessing task completion.

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate CUAWright across live and long-horizon web, desktop, and computer aided design (CAD) tasks, and show that terminal-centric interaction is effective, efficient, and substantially more robust than GUI native or hybrid interaction.

S6.quote: On Online-Mind2Web and the long horizon Odysseys benchmark, CUAWright substantially outperforms GUI native harness by 4.7% and 44.0% in success rate, respectively.

AP8.quote: Due to computational budget constraints, we evaluate on a subset of 212 samples uniformly sampled across the benchmark-provided difficulty levels

AP15.quote: We evaluated the performance of the GPT-5.4 using CUAWright on the full 300-task Online-Mind2Web benchmark.

title_zh: 面向GUI定位的循环潜在视觉搜索
one_line: Recurrent latent visual search: a patch-attention head refines a spatial focus coarse-to-fine in one pass; ScreenSpot-Pro 53.2->56.3 over same-data baseline, grounding only.

online_eval.quote: We use point grounding accuracy ( Lin et al., 2025 ) : a prediction is correct when its click coordinate lies inside the ground-truth bounding box.

held_out_env.quote: Among the compared methods without external tools, ReLaViS achieves the highest five-benchmark average (68.1%) and average over the four out-of-domain benchmarks excluding UI-Vision (72.7%, versus 71.5% for the next-best InfiGUI-G1-7B).

variance.quote: For models trained in this work, results are reported as mean \pm std over three random seeds.

strong_baselines.quote: For controlled comparisons, we train two single-step-7B baselines using the same backbone and data as ReLaViS-7B, with matched training settings

budget_matched.quote: Notably, on ScreenSpot-Pro, ReLaViS leads methods without external tools with 56.3% accuracy, outperforming the coordinate-free baseline by 3.1 pp with only 3.5% more inference FLOPs

cost_reported.quote: while its latency is 2.19 s/sample, compared with 11.97, 2.34, 9.69, and 4.67 s/sample under the respective implementations

title_zh: TeleTune：从离线遥测日志演化智能体技能
one_line: Learns a textual skill library from goal-free, non-replayable logs via teacher-forced action-prediction validation; beats AWM on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web over three seeds.
one_line_zh: 从无目标不可重放日志学习技能库并离线验证，WorkArena与OM2W优于AWM

online_eval.quote: (1) WorkArena: a suite of knowledge-work tasks on a live ServiceNow instance ( Drouin et al., 2024 ) .

held_out_env.quote: To align the training and test domains and to reduce cost, we keep only test tasks whose website category also appears in the original Mind2Web training set

variance.quote: Every method runs on the same test tasks with three seeds.

strong_baselines.quote: Experiments on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web show that TeleTune outperforms random retrieval, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and their combination.

budget_matched.quote: All methods share the same model, test tasks, and step budget.

cost_reported.quote: On L1, it uses 636.9K input tokens per episode against 343.4K to 386.1K for the baselines

component_ablation.quote: Skill optimization is the larger single factor. With random retrieval, it improves success by 18.6\% on L1, 6.6\% on L2, and 2.2\% on Online-Mind2Web.

validator_check.quote: Following Xue et al. (2025) , we judge the completed trajectories with WebJudge using o4-mini .

evidence_level.quote: (1) WorkArena: a suite of knowledge-work tasks on a live ServiceNow instance ( Drouin et al., 2024 ) .

title_zh: 想象以行动：基于图像编辑世界模型的高保真数据合成用于可扩展GUI智能体训练
one_line: Delta-text-conditioned image-editing world model synthesises mobile trajectories; synthetic-only SFT lifts AndroidWorld and MobileWorld, but trails real-data SFT; VLM-judged fidelity.
one_line_zh: 差分文本条件图像编辑世界模型合成移动轨迹，纯合成SFT提升但不及真实数据。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate our model on AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) and MobileWorld ( Kong et al., 2025 ) , two online benchmarks that require completing end-to-end tasks in dynamic mobile environments

strong_baselines.quote: Similarly, for the GUI agent, we compare general-purpose VLMs (Claude-Sonnet-4.5, Gemini-3-Flash, MiniMax-M3, MiMo-V2.5, Kimi-K2.6), GUI-specialized GUI-Owl-1.5 (2B/4B/8B), and base-model Qwen3-VL (2B/4B/8B).

title_zh: CLIFT：用于网页智能体训练与测试时扩展的共形自我验证
one_line: Conformally certified self-verification questions densify GRPO step rewards and select among retries at test time; WAI 61.8->74.6, VWA and OM2W transfer, judge-certified only.
one_line_zh: 共形认证自验证问题库加密步级奖励并做测试时轨迹选择，WAI提升12.8点。

online_eval.quote: WAI is the primary training setting: its self-hosted SaaS-style apps expose programmatic verifiers that can support online RL and public-board comparison.

held_out_env.quote: Training tasks are synthesized without reading evaluation tasks. WAI seeds come from app descriptions; VWA seeds come from SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) site exploration.

strong_baselines.quote: The comparison isolates three effects: the base browser-use backbone, vanilla GRPO with the same comparative judge but no certified bank, and CLIFT with certified step-level feedback.

budget_matched.quote: For CTS rows, K denotes rollout budget and one selected trajectory is emitted per task.

cost_reported.quote: The reported checkpoint trains on 1{,}886 WAI tasks and 1{,}272 VWA tasks across 16 LoRA shards.

component_ablation.quote: Training accounts for most of the WAI gain, while CTS improves five apps, ties four, and never lowers the single-rollout CLIFT anchor.

validator_check.quote: a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge

evidence_level.quote: WAI is the primary training setting: its self-hosted SaaS-style apps expose programmatic verifiers that can support online RL and public-board comparison.

S3.quote: assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline

F3.quote: if that judge is systematically biased, calibration can detect disagreement only through observed data.

AP4.quote: a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge

AP5.quote: Training tasks are synthesized without reading evaluation tasks. WAI seeds come from app descriptions; VWA seeds come from SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) site exploration.

AP6.quote: the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge
